title: Utility Line Protection Plans Restoration Note: Lawn Excavation Rates
content:
# Restoration Note: Lawn Excavation Rates

Field restoration note for yards dug up by open-trench line work under the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## Rule

Lawn excavation rate: where the plan replaces whole lines after repeat breaks, which is when its full replacement break count is above zero, and the most recent completed repair on the same line was completed no more than the plan's replacement lookback days before the request date, the lawn restoration figure takes the whole-run lawn rate, because the trench follows the whole line across the yard; for a recall where those two conditions do not both hold, it takes the re-dig lawn rate; every other request takes a lawn excavation rate of one. The lawn excavation rate multiplies the plan's landscaping restoration allowance in the lawn restoration figure.

## Plan figures

| Plan | Full-replacement break count | Replacement lookback |
|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Exterior Electrical Line Plan | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Exterior Sewer and Septic Line Plan | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan | 0 | 0 days |
| Bridgewell Water and Sewer Line Bundle | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan | 2 | 730 days |

## Rates

| Situation on the records | Lawn excavation rate |
|---|---|
| break count above zero and the last completed repair on the same line within the lookback | 2 (whole-run lawn rate) |
| a recall, the two conditions not both holding | 0.5 (re-dig lawn rate) |
| a new failure, the two conditions not both holding | 1 |

## Boundary cases (a 730-day lookback)

- Last completed repair on the line 730 days before the request date: 2. At 731 days: 0.5 for a recall, 1 for a new failure.

## Hypothetical examples (an allowance of $250.00 assumed)

- Whole-run: $250.00 multiplied by 2 is $500.00.
- Re-dig: $250.00 multiplied by 0.5 is $125.00.
